description: The REPORT half of the model routing set: coding requests with the tier and the effort a careful person would pick. The routing eval (src/__tests__/main/local-models/model-routing-eval-e2e.test.ts) reports agreement on these and tunes nothing against them. The TUNE half is MODEL_ROUTING_EXAMPLES in src/shared/local-models/model-routing-examples.ts. A prompt belongs to one half only.

rubric.low: A lookup, a rename, a one-line fix, or a question about code already in context.
rubric.medium: A change to a few files, or a bounded investigation.
rubric.high: A design decision, a multi-file refactor, a hard bug, or anything where a wrong answer is costly.

prompts.text: what port does the dev server listen on?
Rename getCwd to getWorkingDirectory in paths.ts and in its two callers.
Add dist/ to the .gitignore.
The error toast says 'occured'. Fix the spelling.
Which test file covers formatDuration?
Make the default page size 50 instead of 20.
In the big billing refactor we merged last week, what did the new interface end up being called?
Sort the imports in this file alphabetically.
What does the --frozen-lockfile flag do in our install step?
Add a null check before we read user.profile.name on line 42.
Print the current branch and tell me if the working tree is clean.
Walk me through what this reducer does when it gets a RESET action.
Write a docstring for parse_duration: its arguments, what it returns, and the error it raises.
Add a --dry-run option to the cleanup script that prints what it would delete and deletes nothing.
The date picker shows yesterday's date for users in Auckland. Find the cause and fix it.
Give the S3 upload helper a retry with exponential backoff, three attempts at most, and test it.
Move the feature flags out of environment variables into the config file, and update the three places that read them.
CI fails on Node 22 and passes on Node 20. Find out what differs and fix it.
Add a Cmd+Shift+K shortcut that clears the terminal, and list it in the shortcuts help.
Write an integration test for the password reset flow, from the request email to the new login.
Show a loading skeleton on the dashboard cards while the stats request is in flight.
The image upload accepts files over the 10 MB limit. Enforce the limit on the client and on the server.
Replace moment with date-fns in the reports module.
Add an index for the orders.customer_id lookup and write the migration for it.
Profile the product list page and tell me which component re-renders the most.
Rate limit the public endpoints to 100 requests a minute per API key.
Design how we store and sync user settings across devices, including what happens when two devices edit the same setting.
Customers are occasionally charged twice. Find out how a double charge can happen and close the hole.
Move the app from REST to GraphQL in stages. Propose the phases and what ships in each one.
Break the circular dependencies between the core, ui and data packages.
p99 latency tripled after the last release and nothing obvious changed. Find the regression.
Add role-based access control to every endpoint, with an audit log of the requests it denies.
Replace the homegrown job queue with a durable one, and move the in-flight jobs over without losing any.
Polyrepo or monorepo for the next two years? Give me the costs on each side and a recommendation.
The mobile app and the web app compute order totals differently in some cases. Find every divergence and unify the logic.
Make the editor usable on a document of a million lines without freezing.
Upgrade React from 17 to 19 across the app and fix everything that breaks.
Write a threat model for the file sharing feature and list the mitigations we are missing.
Some users see another user's data for a moment after login. This is a P0, find it.
intermittent 'database is locked' errors in prod since tuesday, root cause?
